senses.en_definition: A wall or partition enclosing or dividing a building, room, or other space.
A structure resembling a wall that encloses, protects, or separates something, such as an organ or cell.

messages.en: Do you want to hang this picture on the wall next to the door?
Might be a bit cramped there. There's still room above the sofa.
True. I'll hold it up there first, and you can see if it looks right.

senses.en_definition: Called or summoned to come or appear before someone.

collocations.en: be summoned to appear before someone
be called to give a statement

senses.en_definition: Invited to attend an event or gathering.

collocations.en: be asked to attend a meeting

senses.en_definition: Known or referred to by a particular name or title.

collocations.en: be called by a particular name

messages.en: Aina was called into the boss's office a little while ago. Shall we wait for her before we start?
Let's give her a minute. She said she'd only need five minutes. Get the slides up first.
Do you still need a copy of my ID card? I handed one in yesterday.
No, the copy you handed in is enough. Just keep the original.

senses.en_definition: One's own person, body, or individual identity.
To stand upright on one's feet, usually in the form berdiri.

collocations.en: stand at the front of the classroom

senses.en_definition: To build a structure or establish an organization, in the form mendirikan.

messages.en: Take care of yourself over there, okay? Don't get so caught up in work that you forget to eat.
Of course. I've already eaten. You take care of yourself too, and don't stay up too late.
